answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through bonded peer vouching, where nodes stake crypto-assets to endorse new participants. This bridges the verification canyon, ensuring forged identities cannot sweep through like a costless zephyr by imposing a scarce capital cost per persona. Over time, each node preserves its record as a pearl of bonded reputation that is slashed upon fraud. However, this framework inherently favors wealthy cartels over resource-poor honest agents.
